verses.geez: ሊተ፡ ለአቡክሙ፡ ስምዑኒ፡ ደቂቅየ፡ ወከመዝ፡ ግበሩ፡ ከመ፡ ትሕየዉ።
verses.translation: Hear me your father, O children, and do thereafter, that ye may be safe.

translations.lxx: Hear me your father, O children, and do thereafter, that ye may be safe.
translations.ron: Fiilor, ascultaţi-mă pe mine, tatăl, şi vă purtaţi aşa ca să vă mântuiţi,
translations.grk: Ἐμοῦ τοῦ πατρὸς ἀκούσατε τέκνα, καὶ οὕτως ποιήσατε, ἵνα σωθῆτε.

verses.geez: እስመ፡ አክበረ፡ እግዚአብሔር፡ አበ፡ ላዕለ፡ ውሉድ፡ ወአዕበየ፡ ኵነኔሃ፡ ለእም፡ ላዕለ፡ ደቂቃ።
verses.translation: For the Lord hath given the father honour over the children, and hath confirmed the authority of the mother over the sons.

translations.lxx: For the Lord hath given the father honour over the children, and hath confirmed the authority of the mother over the sons.
translations.ron: Că Domnul a înălţat pe tată peste fii şi a întărit judecata mamei peste copii.
translations.grk: Ὁ γὰρ Κύριος ἐδόξασε πατέρα ἐπὶ τέκνοις, καὶ κρίσιν μητρὸς ἐστερέωσεν ἐφʼ υἱοῖς.

verses.geez: ዘያከብር፡ አባሁ፡ ይትኀደግ፡ ሎቱ፡ ኀጢአቱ።
verses.translation: Whoso honoureth his father maketh an atonement for his sins:

translations.lxx: Whoso honoureth his father maketh an atonement for his sins:
translations.ron: Cel care cinsteşte pe tată se va curăţi de păcat.
translations.grk: Ὁ τιμῶν πατέρα ἐξιλάσεται ἁμαρτίαις.

verses.geez: ወከመ፡ ዘይዘግብ፡ መዝገበ፡ ዘያከብራ፡ ለእሙ።
verses.translation: and he that honoureth his mother is as one that layeth up treasure.

translations.lxx: and he that honoureth his mother is as one that layeth up treasure.
translations.ron: Şi ca acel care strânge comori, aşa este cel care cinsteşte pe mama sa.
translations.grk: Καὶ ὡς ὁ ἀποθησαυρίζων, ὁ δοξάζων μητέρα αὐτοῦ.

verses.geez: ዘያከብር፡ አባሁ፡ ይትፌሣሕ፡ በውሉዱ፡ ወበዕለተ፡ ጸሎቱ፡ ይሰምዖ፡ ፈጣሪሁ።
verses.translation: Whoso honoureth his father shall have joy of his own children; and when he maketh his prayer, he shall be heard.

translations.lxx: Whoso honoureth his father shall have joy of his own children; and when he maketh his prayer, he shall be heard.
translations.ron: Cel care cinsteşte pe tată se va veseli de fii şi în ziua rugăciunii sale va fi auzit.
translations.grk: Ὁ τιμῶν πατερα εὐφρανθήσεται ὑπὸ τέκνων, καὶ ἐν ἡμέρᾳ προσευχῆς αὐτοῦ εἰσακουσθήσεται.

verses.geez: ዘያከብር፡ አባሁ፡ ይነውኅ፡ መዋዕሊሁ።
verses.translation: He that honoureth his father shall have a long life; and he that is obedient unto the Lord shall be a comfort to his mother,

translations.lxx: He that honoureth his father shall have a long life; and he that is obedient unto the Lord shall be a comfort to his mother,
translations.ron: Cel care măreşte pe tată va avea viaţă lungă, şi cel care se teme de Domnul cinsteşte pe mama sa.
translations.grk: Ὁ δοξάζων πατέρα μακροημερεύσει, καὶ ὁ εἰσακούων Κυρίου ἀναπαύσει μητέρα αὐτοῦ,

verses.geez: ወዘይሰምዖ፡ ለእግዚአብሔር፡ የአርፋ፡ ለእሙ።
verses.translation: and will do service unto his parents, as to his masters.

translations.lxx: and will do service unto his parents, as to his masters.
translations.ron: Cel care se teme de Domnul va cinsti pe tatăl său şi ca stăpânitor va sluji celor care l-au născut.
translations.grk: καὶ ὡς δεσπόταις δουλεύσει ἐν τοῖς γεννήσασιν αὐτόν.

verses.geez: ወከመ፡ አግብርቲሁ፡ ይትቀነይ፡ ለዘወለዶ።
verses.translation: Honour thy father and mother both in word and deed, that a blessing may come upon thee from them.

translations.lxx: Honour thy father and mother both in word and deed, that a blessing may come upon thee from them.
translations.ron: Cu fapta şi cu cuvântul cinsteşte pe tatăl tău şi pe mama ta, ca să-ţi vină binecuvântare de la ei.
translations.grk: Ἐν ἔργῳ καὶ λόγῳ τίμα τὸν πατέρα σου, ἵνα ἐπέλθῃ σοι εὐλογία παρʼ αὐτοῦ.

verses.geez: በቃልከኒ፡ ወበምግባሪከኒ፡ አክብሮ፡ ለአቡከ፡ ከመ፡ ትብጻሕከ፡ በረከቱ።
verses.translation: For the blessing of the father establisheth the houses of children; but the curse of the mother rooteth out foundations.

translations.lxx: For the blessing of the father establisheth the houses of children; but the curse of the mother rooteth out foundations.
translations.ron: Că binecuvântarea tatălui întăreşte casele fiilor, iar blestemul mamei le dărâmă până în temelie.
translations.grk: Εὐλογία γὰρ πατρὸς στηρίζει οἴκους τέκνων, κατάρα δὲ μητρὸς ἐκριζοῖ θεμέλια.

verses.geez: መድኅረ፡ አብ፡ ያጸንዕ፡ አብያተ፡ ውሉድ፡ ወመርገም፡ እም፡ ይሤሩ፡ መሠረተ።
verses.translation: Glory not in the dishonour of thy father; for thy father's dishonour is no glory unto thee.

translations.lxx: Glory not in the dishonour of thy father; for thy father's dishonour is no glory unto thee.
translations.ron: Nu căuta mărire întru necinstea tatălui tău, că necinstea tatălui tău nu-ţi este mărire.
translations.grk: Μὴ δοξάζου ἐν ἀτιμίᾳ πατρός σου, οὐ γάρ ἐστί σοι δόξα πατρὸς ἀτιμία.

verses.geez: ኢትትመካሕ፡ በአስተሐቅሮቱ፡ ለአቡከ፡ እስመ፡ ኢይከውነከ፡ ምክሖ፡ አስተሐቅሮ፡ አቡከ፡ እስመ፡ በክብረ፡ አቡሁ፡ ይከብር፡ ሰብእ፡ ወኀሣሩ፡ ለሰብእ፡ አስተሐቅሮታ፡ ለእሙ።
verses.translation: For the glory of a man is from the honour of his father; and a mother in dishonour is a reproach to the children.

translations.lxx: For the glory of a man is from the honour of his father; and a mother in dishonour is a reproach to the children.
translations.ron: Că mărirea omului este din cinstea tatălui său şi ocară este fiilor mama necinstită.
translations.grk: Ἡ γὰρ δόξα ἀνθρώπου ἐκ τιμῆς πατρὸς αὐτοῦ, καὶ ὄνειδος τέκνοις μήτηρ ἐν ἀδοξίᾳ.

verses.geez: ወልድየ፡ ፁር፡ ርስዓኒሁ፡ ለአቡከ፡ ወኢታሕዝኖ፡ በሕይወቱ።
verses.translation: My son, help thy father in his age, and grieve him not as long as he liveth.

translations.lxx: My son, help thy father in his age, and grieve him not as long as he liveth.
translations.ron: Fiule, sprijină pe tatăl tău la bătrâneţe şi nu-l mâhni în viaţa lui.
translations.grk: Τέκνον, ἀντιλαβοῦ ἐν γήρᾳ πατρός σου, καὶ μὴ λυπήσῃς αὐτὸν ἐν τῇ ζωῇ αὐτοῦ.

verses.geez: ወእመኒ፡ ልህቀ፡ ወኀጥአ፡ ልቦ፡ ኦሆ፡ በሎ፡ ለግዕዙ፡ ወአክብሮ፡ በአምጣነ፡ ትክል፡ ወኢታስተአክዮ፡ በርስዓኑ፡ ለአቡከ፡ እስመ፡ ምጽዋቱ፡ ለአቡከ፡ ዕሤተ፡ ኢትትረሣዕ፡ ለከ።
verses.translation: And if his understanding fail, have patience with him; and despise him not when thou art in thy full strength.

translations.lxx: And if his understanding fail, have patience with him; and despise him not when thou art in thy full strength.
translations.ron: Şi chiar de i se va împuţina mintea lui, ai îndurare şi nu-l dispreţui când tu eşti în putere,
translations.grk: Κᾂν ἀπολείπῃ σύνεσιν, συγγνώμην ἔχε, καὶ μὴ ἀτιμάσῃς αὐτὸν ἐν πάσῃ ἰσχύϊ σου.

verses.geez: ወህየንተ፡ ኀጢአት፡ ትትሐነጽ፡ ለከ፡ ጽድቅ።
verses.translation: For the relieving of thy father shall not be forgotten: and instead of sins it shall be added to build thee up.

translations.lxx: For the relieving of thy father shall not be forgotten: and instead of sins it shall be added to build thee up.
translations.ron: Pentru că milostenia arătată tatălui nu va fi uitată şi, în pofida păcatelor, se va zidi casa ta.
translations.grk: Ἐλεημοσύνη γὰρ πατρὸς οὐκ ἐπιλησθήσεται, καὶ ἀντὶ ἁμαρτιῶν προσανοικοδομηθήσεταί σοι.

verses.geez: ወበዕለተ፡ ምንዳቤከ፡ ይዜከራ፡ ለከ፡ ከመ፡ ይመስዎ፡ ፀሓይ፡ ለበረድ፡ ከማሁ፡ ያትመሰዋ፡ ኃጣውኢከ።
verses.translation: In the day of thine affliction it shall be remembered; thy sins also shall melt away, as the ice in the fair warm weather.

translations.lxx: In the day of thine affliction it shall be remembered; thy sins also shall melt away, as the ice in the fair warm weather.
translations.ron: În ziua necazului tău Îşi va aduce aminte Domnul de tine şi, ca gheaţa când este senin, aşa se vor topi păcatele tale.
translations.grk: Ἐν ἡμέρᾳ θλίψεώς σου ἀναμνησθήσεταί σου· ὡς εὐδία ἐπὶ παγετῷ, οὕτως ἀναλυθήσονταί σου αἱ ἁμαρτίαι.

verses.geez: ጽሩፍ፡ ውእቱ፡ ዘይገድፎ፡ ለአቡሁ፡ ወርጉም፡ ውእቱ፡ በኀበ፡ እግዚአብሔር፡ ዘያምዕዓ፡ ለእሙ።
verses.translation: He that forsaketh his father is as a blasphemer; and he that angereth his mother is cursed of God.

translations.lxx: He that forsaketh his father is as a blasphemer; and he that angereth his mother is cursed of God.
translations.ron: Ca un hulitor este cel care părăseşte pe tată şi blestemat de Domnul este cel care mânie pe mama sa.
translations.grk: Ὡς βλάσφημος ὁ ἐγκαταλιπὼν πατέρα, καὶ κεκατηραμένος ὑπὸ Κυρίου ὁ παροργίζων μητέρα αὐτοῦ.

verses.geez: ወልድየ፡ በሃይማኖትከ፡ ያስተርኢ፡ ምግባሪከ፡ ወያፈቅሩከ፡ ዕደው፡ ጻድቃን።
verses.translation: My son, go on with thy business in meekness; so shalt thou be beloved of him that is approved.

translations.lxx: My son, go on with thy business in meekness; so shalt thou be beloved of him that is approved.
translations.ron: Fiule, cu blândeţe săvârşeşte lucrurile tale şi de omul cel primit de Domnul vei fi iubit.
translations.grk: Τέκνον, ἐν πραΰτητι τὰ ἔργα σου διέξαγε, καὶ ὑπὸ ἀνθρώπου δεκτοῦ ἀγαπηθήσῃ.

verses.geez: በአምጣነ፡ ዕበይከ፡ ከማሁ፡ አትሕት፡ ርእሰከ፡ ወትረክብ፡ ዕሴተ፡ በኀበ፡ እግዚአብሔር።
verses.translation: The greater thou art, the more humble thyself, and thou shalt find favour before the Lord.

translations.lxx: The greater thou art, the more humble thyself, and thou shalt find favour before the Lord.
translations.ron: Cu cât eşti mai mare, cu atât mai mult te smereşte şi înaintea Domnului vei afla har.
translations.grk: Ὅσῳ μέγας εἶ, τοσούτῳ ταπεινοῦ σεαυτὸν, καὶ ἔναντι Κυρίου εὑρήσεις χάριν.

verses.geez: እስመ፡ ዐቢይ፡ ግብሩ፡ ለእግዚአብሔር፡ ወይሴባሕ፡ በላዕለ፡ ትሑታን፡ ወቅዱሳን።
verses.translation: For the power of the Lord is great, and he is honoured of the lowly.

translations.lxx: For the power of the Lord is great, and he is honoured of the lowly.
translations.ron: Cele mai presus de tine nu le căuta şi cele mai tari decât tine nu le iscodi.
translations.grk: Ὅτι μεγάλη ἡ δυναστεία τοῦ Κυρίου, καὶ ὑπὸ τῶν ταπεινῶν δοξάζεται.

verses.geez: ኢትኅሥሥ፡ ዘይጸንዐከ፡ ወኢትሕትት፡ ዘኢይትከሃለከ፡ ሐሊ፡ ዳእሙ፡ ዘተአዘዝከ።
verses.translation: Seek not out the things that are too hard for thee, neither search the things that are above thy strength.

translations.lxx: Seek not out the things that are too hard for thee, neither search the things that are above thy strength.
translations.ron: Cele ce s-au poruncit ţie, acelea cu cuviinţă le cugetă, că nu-ţi sunt de nevoie cele ascunse.
translations.grk: Χαλέπωτερά σου μὴ ζήτει, καὶ ἰσχυρότερά σου μὴ ἐξέταζε,

verses.geez: ወዘኅቡዕሰ፡ ኢያስተኀልፈከ።
verses.translation: But what is commanded thee, think thereupon with reverence; for it is not needful for thee to see with thine eyes the things that are in secret.

translations.lxx: But what is commanded thee, think thereupon with reverence; for it is not needful for thee to see with thine eyes the things that are in secret.
translations.ron: În multele tale îndeletniciri nu te ţine de lucrurile zadarnice, că ţi s-au descoperit destule din cunoştinţele omeneşti.
translations.grk: ἃ προσετάγη σοι, ταῦτα διανοοῦ· οὐ γάρ ἐστί σοι χρεία τῶν κρυπτῶν.

verses.geez: ወኢትኅሥሥ፡ በብዝኀ፡ ምግባሪከ፡ እስመ፡ ፈድፋደ፡ እምነ፡ ሰብእ፡ ዘአርአዩከ፡ ለከ።
verses.translation: Be not curious in unnecessary matters; for more things are shewed unto thee than men understand.

translations.lxx: Be not curious in unnecessary matters; for more things are shewed unto thee than men understand.
translations.ron: Că pe mulţi i-a înşelat părerea lor şi socoteala rea a făcut să alunece cugetele lor.
translations.grk: Ἐν τοῖς περισσοῖς τῶν ἔργων σου μὴ περιεργάζου· πλείονα γὰρ συνέσεως ἀνθρώπων ὑπεδείχθη σοι.

verses.geez: ወለብዙኃን፡ አስሐቶሙ፡ ትዝኅርቶሙ፡ ወለብዙኃን፡ አውደቆሙ፡ ትዕቢተ፡ ልቦሙ።
verses.translation: For many are deceived by their own vain opinion; and an evil suspicion hath overthrown their judgment.

translations.lxx: For many are deceived by their own vain opinion; and an evil suspicion hath overthrown their judgment.
translations.ron: Inima îndărătnică rău va păţi mai pe urmă.
translations.grk: Πολλοὺς γὰρ ἐπλάνησεν ἡ ὑπόληψις αὐτῶν, καὶ ὑπόνοια πονηρὰ ὠλίσθησε διανοίας αὐτῶν.

verses.geez: ዘይፈትዋ፡ ለመንሱት፡ ባቲ፡ ይመውት፡ ልብ፡ እኩይ፡ ይደዊ፡ በደኃሪቱ።
verses.translation: A stubborn heart shall fare evil at the last; and he that loveth danger shall perish therein.

translations.lxx: A stubborn heart shall fare evil at the last; and he that loveth danger shall perish therein.
translations.ron: Inima îndărătnică se va împovăra cu osteneli şi cel păcătos va adăuga păcate peste păcate.
translations.grk: Καὶ ὁ ἀγαπῶν κίνδυνον, ἐν αὐτῷ ἐμπεσεῖται· καρδία σκληρὰ κακωθήσεται ἐπʼ ἐσχάτων.

verses.geez: ልብ፡ እኩይ፡ ይትቀሠፍ፡ በሕማም፡ ወኃጥእሰ፡ ይዌስክ፡ ኀጢአተ፡ በላዕለ፡ ኃጣውኢሁ።
verses.translation: An obstinate heart shall be laden with sorrows; and the wicked man shall heap sin upon sin.

translations.lxx: An obstinate heart shall be laden with sorrows; and the wicked man shall heap sin upon sin.
translations.ron: Ispitele nu sunt lecuire pentru cel trufaş, că buruiană rea s-a înrădăcinat în inima lui.
translations.grk: Καρδία σκληρὰ βαρυνθήσεται πόνοις, καὶ ὁ ἁμαρτωλὸς προσθήσει ἁμαρτίαν ἐφʼ ἁμαρτίαις.

verses.geez: መንሱቶሙ፡ ለዕቡያን፡ አልባቲ፡ ፈውሰ፡ እስመ፡ እኩይ፡ ተክል፡ ገብረ፡ ሥርወ፡ ላዕሌሆሙ።
verses.translation: In the punishment of the proud there is no remedy; for the plant of wickedness hath taken root in him.

translations.lxx: In the punishment of the proud there is no remedy; for the plant of wickedness hath taken root in him.
translations.ron: Inima celui înţelept va cugeta la pildele celor înţelepţi, şi o ureche ascultătoare este dorinţa celui înţelept.
translations.grk: Ἐπαγωγὴ ὑπερηφάνου οὐκ ἔστιν ἴασις, φυτὸν γὰρ πονηρίας ἐῤῥίζωκεν ἐν αὐτῷ·

verses.geez: ልበ፡ ጠቢብ፡ ይፌክር፡ አምሳለ፡ ወእዝነ፡ ማዕምር፡ ትፈቱ፡ ጥበበ።
verses.translation: The heart of the prudent will understand a parable; and an attentive ear is the desire of a wise man.

translations.lxx: The heart of the prudent will understand a parable; and an attentive ear is the desire of a wise man.
translations.ron: Focul arzător îl va stinge apa, şi milostenia va curăţi păcatele.
translations.grk: καρδία συνετοῦ διανοηθήσεται παραβολὴν, καὶ οὖς ἀκροατοῦ ἐπιθυμία σοφοῦ.

verses.geez: ለእሳት፡ እንተ፡ ትነድድ፡ ያጠፍዓ፡ ማይ፡ ወምጽዋት፡ ተኀድግ፡ ኀጢአተ።
verses.translation: Water will quench a flaming fire; and alms maketh an atonement for sins.

translations.lxx: Water will quench a flaming fire; and alms maketh an atonement for sins.
translations.ron: Cel ce răsplăteşte pentru binefacere, acela se gândeşte la viitor şi la vreme de cădere va afla sprijin.
translations.grk: Πῦρ φλογιζόμενον ἀποσβέσει ὕδωρ, καὶ ἐλεημοσύνη ἐξιλάσεται ἁμαρτίας.

verses.geez: ለዘይፈዲ፡ ዕሴተ፡ ይዜከራ፡ ሎቱ፡ ለደኃሪቱ፡ ወአመ፡ ዕለተ፡ ይድኅፅ፡ ይረክብ፡ በዘያሰምከ።
verses.translation: And he that requiteth good turns is mindful of that which may come hereafter; and when he falleth, he shall find a stay.

translations.lxx: And he that requiteth good turns is mindful of that which may come hereafter; and when he falleth, he shall find a stay.
translations.grk: Ὁ ἀνταποδιδοὺς χάριτας μέμνηται εἰς τὰ μετὰ ταῦτα, καὶ ἐν καιρῷ πτώσεως εὑρήσει στήριγμα.
